issue: CW-07 needs_review latch set when a wb-handoff is held because of user background/suspended jobs persists for the whole shell generation, so after the user cleans the jobs a new wb-handoff is held again
decision: C-D58 requires that the user can clean up and run wb-handoff again. Clear ONLY a job-caused latch, and only on a fresh verified handoff whose jobs probe is empty (same verification path as a first handoff); latches caused by unknown/manual residue or unverifiable boundaries stay (fail-safe unchanged). Implement as a CW-07 delta with red->green tests, keeping every other CW-07 invariant and the p27s/independent tests green.
authority: workflow-contract Root adjudication; C-D58; CW-18 ticket
